guarantees.claim: clr_i is permanently tied to 0, disabling the FIFO clear function.
rready_i is permanently tied to 1, so the read port is always ready and seed data is accepted immediately when seed_valid is asserted.
wvalid_i is driven by entropy_ack_i, so write requests to the FIFO occur only when the external entropy source asserts acknowledgment.
wready_o output from the FIFO is left unconnected, so the module does not condition writes on FIFO readiness.
The ClearOnRead parameter is set to 0, so the FIFO retains data after read (no automatic clearing on read).

assumptions.claim: wready_o is assumed to be always high when entropy_ack_i is asserted, because the module ignores it and writes unconditionally.
assumptions.risk: If the FIFO is full (wready_o low), the write is silently dropped and entropy data is lost.

assumptions.claim: entropy_ack_i is a valid single-cycle handshake that indicates entropy_i is valid.
assumptions.risk: If entropy_ack_i toggles incorrectly or entropy_i is not aligned, invalid or multiple data may be captured.

assumptions.claim: The downstream logic must always be ready to accept seed when seed_valid is asserted, because rready_i is permanently 1 and offers no backpressure.
assumptions.risk: If the consumer is not ready, seed data may be lost or mis-sampled (since the FIFO may update next cycle).

assumptions.claim: The FIFO never needs to be cleared (wiped) for security or operational reasons, as clr_i is hardwired to 0.
assumptions.risk: If a security policy requires clearing internal PRNG state, residual seed data may persist.

uncertain_points.claim: wready_o is unconnected; is there a guarantee that the FIFO does not become full when entropy_ack_i is asserted? If not, entropy data can be silently dropped.
uncertain_points.cond: when the FIFO is full and entropy_ack_i is high
uncertain_points.risk: Loss of entropy and potential PRNG weakness if seed words are silently skipped.

uncertain_points.claim: ClearOnRead=0 and clr_i=0 mean the FIFO never clears its contents. Does this violate a requirement to wipe seed data after use or on an event?
uncertain_points.cond: after seed consumption or during error/clear events
uncertain_points.risk: Residual secret seed data may be accessible or leak through later operations.

uncertain_points.claim: With rready_i=1, seed_valid will be asserted as soon as data is packed. Is there a race condition if the consumer latches seed on an edge before seed_valid is fully settled?
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream may sample stale or transitional seed data if not properly synchronized.
